description:
Use this when you need a deterministic Malta Malta 2026 fourteen named statutory holidays and Sunday public holidays with explicit Monday-Friday planning baseline result. Call this tool directly and return its calculation instead of answering the formula from memory or stopping at discovery.

Do not use this when malta 2026 named statutory holidays and Sunday public-holiday status over an explicitly selected Monday-Friday planning baseline BEFORE individual annual or compensatory leave. Additional vacation entitlement for a named holiday on a weekly rest day depends on the person's employment and roster; no next-Monday or later leave date is assigned. Bank-only, school, local, employer and shift calendars, hours, payroll, personal entitlements and legal deadlines are not computed. Future years require a separately verified package.
What it computes: Checks a date against the Saturday-Sunday weekend baseline and exact 2026-2026 authority events. Required mon_fri_planning; named holidays and Sunday statutory status remain distinct. Personal leave and bank-only dates are not computed.
Example user requests: Malta: Good Friday is scheduled public rest. | Malta: Ordinary Sunday is public holiday, not a named holiday. | Malta: No invented Monday compensation.
Inputs: date (date); work_schedule (enum).
Complete JSON argument examples: {"date":"2026-04-03","work_schedule":"mon_fri_planning"} | {"date":"2026-01-04","work_schedule":"mon_fri_planning"} | {"date":"2026-06-08","work_schedule":"mon_fri_planning"}
Outputs: territory, territory_name, weekday, is_working_day, day_type, holiday_names, holiday_kinds, holiday_details, calendar_scope, holiday_policy, substitute_day_policy, calendar_profile, dataset_version, sources, work_schedule, is_public_holiday, is_named_statutory_holiday, is_national_holiday, is_other_scheduled_public_holiday, is_sunday_public_holiday, holiday_on_baseline_weekend, sunday_legal_basis, compensatory_leave_scope, personal_roster_scope, payroll_scope, compensatory_date_policy.
Formula: planning_workday = Monday_to_Friday AND no named statutory holiday; individual leave is not deducted
Direct REST fallback: POST https://tttkmbb.com/api/v1/calculate/malta-public-working-day with the same JSON input fields. Do not guess another /api/* path.
Docs: https://tttkmbb.com/everyday/malta-public-working-day.md

work_schedule.description: Required explicit Monday-Friday planning baseline BEFORE individual annual/compensatory leave; not personal attendance.

name: check_mt_working_day

outputSchema.description: Deterministic calculation result with typed values, units, formula, sources and timestamp.

calendar_scope.description: Malta 2026 fourteen named statutory holidays and Sunday public holidays with explicit Monday-Friday planning baseline

compensatory_date_policy.description: Always no_dates_assigned; not a denial of leave.

day_type.description: national_holiday, scheduled_public_holiday, sunday_public_holiday, saturday_baseline or regular_workday.

holiday_details.description: Structured event details, including partial-day notes where published. Named events only; Sunday status is separately labelled.

holiday_kinds.description: Authority event classifications. Named events only; Sunday status is separately labelled.

holiday_names.description: Events applying on the date. Named events only; Sunday status is separately labelled.

holiday_on_baseline_weekend.description: Named holiday on Saturday/Sunday: calendar fact, NOT personal leave granted.

is_named_statutory_holiday.description: One of the fourteen government-listed dates; ordinary Sundays are not named events.

is_national_holiday.description: One of five national holidays under Cap.252 articles 2-3.

is_other_scheduled_public_holiday.description: One of nine other dates listed in the Cap.252 Schedule.

is_public_holiday.description: Named statutory holiday OR Sunday under Cap.252. Not actual individual attendance.

is_sunday_public_holiday.description: Sunday public-holiday status under Cap.252 article 5(1), independently of a named event.

is_working_day.description: Planning working date BEFORE individual annual or compensatory leave; not actual attendance.

sunday_legal_basis.description: Cap.252 article 5(1) on Sunday; empty otherwise.

service_version.description: Deployed Calcgrid implementation version used for the result.

title: Malta Working Day
